verdict.rationale: Apify documents monitoring that lets you check Actor performance and receive alerts (apify-docs-7), and the API client can stream run logs in real time (apify-docs-19). This gives some visibility into running jobs, but nothing in the pack describes a real-time dashboard of system metrics or browser/worker pool status. Missing for 10: a documented real-time metrics dashboard, live worker/browser pool status views, details of which metrics are exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
